title: Prayer in the Christian Life
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Prayer in the Christian life is daily dependence on God through worship, confession, thanksgiving, request, intercession, and trust. Prayer is not a performance, but communion with the Father through Christ by the Spirit.
summary: Prayer in the Christian life is daily dependence on God through worship, confession, thanksgiving, request, intercession, and trust. Prayer is not a performance, but communion with the Father through Christ by the Spirit.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives believers access to the Father and teaches them to pray. Through Him, God’s people come boldly for mercy, grace, help, forgiveness, and strength.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Prayer belongs to the ordinary life of discipleship. Believers are told to pray without ceasing, continue steadfastly in prayer, and bring their anxieties to God with thanksgiving.

Prayer includes more than asking for needs. It includes worship, confession, surrender, intercession, lament, gratitude, and listening to God’s Word. Prayer trains the heart to depend on God rather than self.

Believers pray through Christ and with the Spirit’s help. Weakness in prayer does not keep them from God. The Spirit helps, and the throne of grace is open because of Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Prayerlessness often reveals self-reliance, distraction, discouragement, or unbelief. People may talk about God more than they speak to God.

This doctrine invites weary believers back to dependence. Prayer is not reserved for the impressive; it is the lifeline of the needy.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray honestly and regularly. Bring God your worship, sin, fear, needs, gratitude, and weakness. Do not wait until you feel eloquent or strong. Come through Christ, ask the Spirit for help, and let prayer reshape your dependence throughout the day.
